## Release and build

The release is the tag in the name of the zip file you installed, for example
`v1.0.0-beta.1`.

The build is the line that holds `build=` in the client's `logs/lua.log`.

## Log

Attach the client's `logs/lua.log` as a file. Drag it in, and do not paste it.
Copy it before you start the client again, because the client rewrites it at
every start.

## Screenshot

If the problem is about how something looks, add a screenshot.
